topic: One extra mortgage payment a year vs minimum (Dexter vs Fawn)

scenes.narration: One extra payment a year erased four years off her mortgage. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding a tiny house with a banner reading PAID EARLY, comic burst banner reads FOUR YEARS OFF, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dexter and Fawn both buy identical homes with thirty year mortgages.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man dexter and woman fawn standing before two identical houses stamped THIRTY YEAR LOAN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Same loan, same rate, same monthly payment to the dollar.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two matching mortgage statements side by side with identical numbers, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dexter pays exactly the minimum twelve payments every year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, dexter checking off twelve identical payments on a calendar, comic banner reads MINIMUM ONLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His balance barely moves while interest eats most payments.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, dexter watching a huge INTEREST slice swallow his payment, balance bar barely shrinking, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Fawn makes one extra full payment toward principal each year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, fawn dropping a thirteenth payment stamped EXTRA PRINCIPAL onto her mortgage statement, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That extra payment goes straight at the loan balance.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an arrow from a payment labeled EXTRA punching directly into a shrinking BALANCE bar, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Every year her principal shrinks faster than Dexter's ever does.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two balance bars racing down, fawn's dropping much faster than dexter's, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thirty years later Dexter finally finishes his full mortgage.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, tired dexter beside his house with a calendar reading THIRTY YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Fawn paid hers off four years early and saved big interest.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, fawn celebrating with a house stamped PAID OFF, banner reads FOUR YEARS EARLY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She saved over thirty thousand dollars in total interest.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, fawn holding a check labeled THIRTY THOUSAND INTEREST SAVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Add one extra mortgage payment toward principal yearly. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing a whistle, holding a clipboard reading ONE EXTRA PAYMENT, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
